item.title: Article: When Spec-Driven Development Pays Off
item.description: AI coding assistants have become a core part of software development. AI-generated code has shown productivity gains, but it's also contributing to security weaknesses and familiar bug patterns. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Anthropic Is Building a Predictive Surveillance System to Monitor Activists
item.description: Anthropic is building out an extensive monitoring system to keep tabs on activists who oppose the rapid development of artificial intelligence. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Muse, the band, lost its social media handles to Muse, Meta's new AI agent
item.description: The exact circumstances surrounding the changes aren't clear, but Meta execs have accidentally tagged the band instead of their AI agent. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: AI and democracy: the right to resist optimization
item.description: Taiwan's cyber-ambassador Audrey Tang on why the real danger of AI isn't that machines imitate humans, but that humans adapt to machines. (1 source: lobsters)
